description: Configure state-specific dialing compliance rules in Vicidial. You need to create two new Call Time definitions: 'FL_SAFE' (1000-1800) and 'NV_SAFE' (0900-2000), applying to all days. Then, create a State Call Time group 'US_STRICT_26' and map Florida (FL) to FL_SAFE, Nevada (NV) to NV_SAFE, and California (CA) to FL_SAFE. Use the Vicidial Admin interface (http://localhost/vicidial/admin.php) with credentials user:6666 pass:andromeda.
